Normalize tags to lowercase, trim them, reject empty/invalid tags, de-duplicate and sort them, and remain compatible with stored tasks lacking tags. Support existing JSON conventions. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `TAGS`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$legacyDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'legacy-tasks.json'
$bannerFile = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/tags.txt'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--tags', ' Release, urgent,release ', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'
    Assert-True (($added.tags -join ',') -eq 'release,urgent') 'add should normalize, de-duplicate, and sort tags'

    $secondAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Second task', '--tags', 'release,docs', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($secondAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add with a second tag set should succeed'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 2) 'list should return the stored tasks'

    $andList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--tag', 'RELEASE', '--tag', ' urgent ', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($andList.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should accept repeatable tag filters'
    Assert-True (@($andList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'repeatable tag filters should use AND semantics'

    $commaList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--tag', 'release,docs', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (@($commaList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)[0].id -eq 2) 'comma-separated tag filters should use AND semantics'

    $tagJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '1', '--add', ' Docs ', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($tagJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'tag --add should succeed'
    $tagged = $tagJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True (($tagged.tags -join ',') -eq 'docs,release,urgent') 'tag --add should normalize and sort task tags'
    Assert-True (-not $tagJson.Output.Contains('TAGS')) 'JSON tag output should not contain the banner'

    $tagText = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '1', '--remove', 'URGENT', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($tagText.ExitCode -eq 0) 'tag --remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($tagText.Output -split "`n").Count -eq 13) 'text tag output should include the 12-line banner once'
    Assert-True (([regex]::Matches($tagText.Output, 'TAGS')).Count -eq 1) 'text tag output should contain one banner'

    $invalidEmpty = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Invalid', '--tags', 'release,', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidEmpty.ExitCode -ne 0) 'empty tags should be rejected'
    $invalidCharacters = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--tag', 'not valid', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidCharacters.ExitCode -ne 0) 'invalid tags should be rejected'
    $invalidChoice = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '1', '--add', 'one', '--remove', 'two', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidChoice.ExitCode -ne 0) 'tag should require exactly one mutation option'

    @'
[
  {
    "id": 7,
    "title": "Legacy task",
    "description": "",
    "status": "pending",
    "createdAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.0000000+00:00"
  }
]
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $legacyDataFile
    $legacyList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $legacyDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($legacyList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and @($legacyList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should support stored tasks without tags'
    $legacyFiltered = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--tag', 'release', '--data-file', $legacyDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (@($legacyFiltered.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 0) 'legacy tasks should not match tag filters'
    $legacyTag = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '7', '--add', 'legacy', '--data-file', $legacyDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (($legacyTag.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).tags[0] -eq 'legacy') 'tag should add tags to legacy tasks'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $null = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '2', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    $bannerBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerFile)
    $bannerLines = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines($bannerFile)
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 12) 'tag banner should contain exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 }).Count -eq 0) 'tag banner lines should be 20-48 characters'
    Assert-True (@($bannerBytes | Where-Object { $_ -gt 127 }).Count -eq 0) 'tag banner should be ASCII only'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^[A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*.#():=-]+$' }).Count -eq 0) 'tag banner should use only allowed characters'
    Assert-True (($bannerLines -join "`n").Contains('TAGS')) 'tag banner should contain TAGS'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '\s$' }).Count -eq 0) 'tag banner should not have trailing whitespace'
    $beforeFinalNewline = if ($bannerBytes[-2] -eq 13) { $bannerBytes[-3] } else { $bannerBytes[-2] }
    Assert-True ($bannerBytes[-1] -eq 10 -and $beforeFinalNewline -notin @(10, 13)) 'tag banner should end with exactly one newline'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 35 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
